formal-guide.rule: Use 您 only when a reader pronoun is necessary; otherwise omit the pronoun.

developer-tool.rule: Use concise second-person developer prose; preserve the source tone when it directly addresses tool users.

prompt-example.rule: Treat the prompt body as user-facing localized prose while preserving code, identifiers, and placeholders.

global.rule: Preserve the source product scope without adding China-only substitutions.

china-saas.rule: Do not import Global-only providers, regions, billing, availability, limits, or product claims; use only reviewed identity overrides.

byoc.rule: Preserve BYOC deployment scope and do not infer SaaS-only behavior.

styleRules: Use natural, concise Simplified Chinese developer-documentation prose.
Use Chinese punctuation and readable spaces around English product terms and inline code.
Use verb-object operation headings and stable noun phrases for concept headings.
Preserve source meaning, conditions, intensity, and product scope without additions or omissions.
Use actual localized UI labels when verified; otherwise preserve the source UI label.

examples.note: Fenced code comments are protected bytes.
